decision: Single-schema, RLS-enforced, schema-structural tenant isolation identical in silo (N=1) and future pooled (N>1) — one isolation code-path, zero drift. Every tenant-owned table carries tenant_id uuid NOT NULL (no default) as leading column of PK/composite indexes/FKs; uniqueness scoped to (tenant_id, business_key). Every tenant table has ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, default-DENY, one permissive policy comparing tenant_id to transaction-local GUC current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true). App connects as non-superuser, non-owner, NOBYPASSRLS role choros_app; separate choros_migrator owns DDL and is never used at runtime. Tenant context set only via SET LOCAL / set_config('choros.tenant_id',$1,true) in an explicit transaction. Async/worker/Flowable-external-worker paths set context explicitly and fail closed if absent. audit_log is an ordinary tenant table. Every inbound request validates JWT signature plus iss/aud/tenant-claim, rejecting mismatches 401/403. Proportional: minimal standard Postgres RLS, no custom engine. Design-only: SQL/migrations/role provisioning land in T-0053.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Catalog bloat in low hundreds, no legal benefit, doubles migration/test/audit surface, second isolation code-path. Rejected source §5.
Isolation becomes discipline not structure (NF-2); one missing WHERE = silent cross-tenant leak; cannot satisfy default-DENY AC-3/6/7.

rejected_alternatives.option: App role with BYPASSRLS / owner / superuser
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Exempt from RLS even with FORCE; apparatus becomes decorative. Violates §9 guard 1 / AC-1.

rejected_alternatives.option: Session-level SET instead of SET LOCAL
rejected_alternatives.why_not: PgBouncer transaction-pooling reuses connection without resetting session GUCs -> context bleed. Forbidden §9 guard 2.
At N=1 global vs scoped uniqueness indistinguishable; later retrofit is multi-year (§4). Defeated by >=2-tenant migration test FF-8/AC-8.

rejected_alternatives.option: SECURITY DEFINER views/functions over tenant tables
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Run with definer/owner rights, bypassing caller RLS — back door around default-DENY. Guarded by FF-13.
Founder decision §5/§11: silo only now; pooled laid into foundation, not implemented until mass cheap SaaS tier. RLS still runs at N=1 for one code-path.

contracts: withTenant<T>(tenantId, fn): fail-closed: throw MissingTenantContextError if tenantId absent/blank BEFORE any query; else BEGIN; set_config('choros.tenant_id',tenantId,true); run fn; COMMIT (ROLLBACK on error). Only sanctioned path to tenant data.
Worker/async entrypoints wrapped: handler(msg) -> withTenant(resolveTenant(msg), tx=>...); resolveTenant undefined => withTenant throws => job aborts (no global run).
Connection contract: app runtime authenticates as choros_app; INVARIANT rolbypassrls=false, rolsuper=false, not owner; no raw tenant-table query outside withTenant.

RLS policy template per tenant table T: ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON T USING (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid) WITH CHECK (same). Default-DENY when GUC unset.

validateToken(jwt, ctx) on EVERY inbound request after signature verify: iss===expectedRealmIssuerUrl else 401; aud includes expectedClientId else 401/403; tenantClaim===ctx.actingTenantId else 401/403; all local, no network round-trip.

fitness_functions.rule: App role lacks BYPASSRLS and superuser
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053): as choros_app SELECT rolbypassrls,rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user MUST be (f,f). Static-now: grep role/migration SQL forbids BYPASSRLS/SUPERUSER on app role.

fitness_functions.rule: FORCE RLS active on every tenant table
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053): pg_class query asserts relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity on all tenant tables; 0 violations.
Live(T-0053): as choros_app with no SET LOCAL, count(*) each tenant table MUST be 0.

fitness_functions.rule: Tenant context transaction-local only; session SET forbidden
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now: ci/checks/no-session-set.sh greps src/ for non-local SET/set_config(...,false) -> fail. Live(T-0053): after COMMIT, count without new SET LOCAL MUST be 0 (AC-4).

fitness_functions.rule: tenant_id leading column of every composite index and FK
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053) ci/checks/tenant_id_leading.sql: for each multi-col index (pg_index) and FK (pg_constraint contype=f) on a tenant table, assert position-1 column is tenant_id; any violation fail.

fitness_functions.rule: Cross-tenant READ from real app role returns 0
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053): seed A and B; as choros_app SET LOCAL choros.tenant_id=A, count WHERE tenant_id=B MUST be 0; unfiltered = A-only.

fitness_functions.rule: Cross-tenant WRITE from app role affects 0 rows
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053): context=A, UPDATE/DELETE WHERE tenant_id=B reports 0 rows; verify B unchanged via choros_migrator.

fitness_functions.rule: Migrations idempotent with >=2 tenants; scoped uniqueness never degenerates
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053): apply migrations, seed >=2 tenant_id per table, re-run suite; no unique-constraint violation / no cross-tenant merge.

fitness_functions.rule: audit_log tenant-scoped, no app-reachable cross-tenant read
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053): context=A count audit_log WHERE tenant_id=B=0, unfiltered A-only. Static-now: grep forbids app-layer audit_log query outside withTenant.

fitness_functions.rule: Fail-closed tenant context in async/worker/Flowable paths
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053) integration: scheduler, inbox consumer, Flowable external-worker stub WITHOUT context MUST throw/abort, 0 tenant rows. Static-now lint: every worker entrypoint wrapped in withTenant.
Live(T-0053) integration: wrong iss=>401; wrong aud=>401/403; tenant-claim!=acting=>401/403 no data. Static-now: validateToken invoked in request-pipeline middleware, no route bypass.

fitness_functions.rule: Scoped uniqueness and tenant_id NOT NULL at DB layer
fitness_functions.ci_check: Live(T-0053): same business_key across two tenants succeeds, duplicate within one tenant=>unique violation; tenant_id=NULL insert (choros_migrator)=>NOT NULL violation.

fitness_functions.rule: No SECURITY DEFINER back door on tenant tables
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now: grep migration SQL forbids SECURITY DEFINER views/functions over tenant tables in app-reachable code. Live(T-0053): pg_proc.prosecdef audit.

traceability.covered_by: template GUC unset => NULL => deny + FF-3

runtime_target: Postgres in a silo docker-compose stack (one tenant per instance) on founder home server (/srv/choros, deploy founder-gated); app connects as non-owner/non-superuser/NOBYPASSRLS choros_app, migrations as choros_migrator; RLS runs at N=1 (one code-path, pooled-ready). Infra dependency NOT built here (Postgres service, pg driver, jobStore->Postgres migration, SQL DDL/migrations/RLS bodies, DB-role provisioning) = T-0053 (E0.3). T-0013 design-only. Server/DB host provisioning is founder gate GT-4.
